# Severity to clock mapping

`customer_support.df.sla_management.severity_to_clock_mapping` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Severity-to-clock mapping — severity selects the clock, so re-examine severity before renegotiating a deadline.

It keeps the negotiation on the object that should carry it. Changing severity is a reviewable decision with a rationale; changing a deadline is a favour, and favours become precedent.
